The '''corpse counters''' was the nickname given to an archaeological salvage group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] tasked by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to count and collect the bodies of the deceased who met their end during the [[Destruction of Taris]] hundreds of years prior. While working in old chemical pipes, the team was ambushed by [[Rakghoul]]s. Only two people survived the attack, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Cera (Human)|Cera]] and a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] named [[Garthe]]. They asked a traveling hero to go and investigate the chemical pipes to see if any of the group survived. None did; but a holo-recording was found of a dying member and it was reveled that he and Garthe had been stealing goods off of the very same bodies they were supposed to be counting. Garthe was later turned in by Cera.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cera, Garthe, and the group known as the corpse counters appeared in the [[2011]] MMORPG game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' produced by [[BioWare]] in the mission titled the same name; "The Corpse Counters".
